answer: Random audit sampling keeps a sybil farm from hiding in volume. Each epoch, a lantern audit picks a small random sample of recent answers and re-checks them against their sources, and the atlas of proven agents only grows when those checks pass. Reputation grows like a cedar, slowly over many clean epochs, and three failed audits quarantine an identity and void its recent rewards. Faking a thousand masks means keeping a thousand histories clean under random light, which costs more than the rewards are worth.
